Each depot holds eight bus bays; each metro set needs two. Driver wages require available residents with basic skills and a street route to the depot. Fare: $0.65 bus / $1.25 metro, including transfers. Building a route authorizes its quoted daily operations; reduce or suspend service to save costs. The commuter-budget policy funds the legacy support service only while no public routes exist.

THE REGIONAL EXCHANGE

Imports are paid inventories on the road, not instant shelf stock. Road exports earn receipts on arrival; river buyers take title at dock collection. Market quotes change monthly; road capacity and working capital limit dispatch. Regional buyers share the conserved external cash account.

WHO PAYS FOR LOCAL SERVICES?

Municipal schools and brigades remain publicly funded. Independent institutions invest their own capital, employ qualified workers and charge voluntary fees. Entry licensing does not confiscate existing providers. Vouchers purchase actual otherwise unaffordable service; they are not a blanket grant to owners.
